title: Ganga Aarti — Dashashwamedh Ghat
description: The world-famous Ganga Aarti performed every evening by seven trained priests in perfect synchrony. Fire meets water in the most moving ritual in all of Kashi.
schedule: Morning Aarti 6:45 AM | Evening Aarti 7:00 PM IST

title: Kashi Vishwanath — Mangala Aarti
location: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Vishwanath Gali, Varanasi
description: Live darshan from one of the twelve Jyotirlingas. The Mangala Aarti at 3 AM is particularly sacred — the city is still, and Shiva is close.
schedule: Mangala Aarti 3:00 AM | Bhog 11:30 AM | Sandhya 7:00 PM | Shringaar 8:00 PM

title: Shri Ram Mandir — Ayodhya
description: Live darshan from the newly consecrated Ram Mandir at the exact birthplace of Shri Ram. One of the most significant temples in modern Hindu history.
schedule: Mangala Aarti 4:30 AM | Shringar 8:00 AM | Rajbhog 12:00 PM | Sandhya 6:30 PM

title: Har Ki Pauri — Haridwar Aarti
description: The most sacred ghat in Haridwar, where the Ganga descends from the mountains to the plains. Evening aarti with thousands of floating diyas.
schedule: Sandhya Aarti daily at sunset (~6:30 PM IST)

title: Kedarnath Temple — Morning Puja
description: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas, nestled in the Himalayas at 3,583m. Only accessible May–November. Pre-dawn puja in the silence of the mountains.

title: Badrinath Temple — Abhishek
description: One of the four Char Dham pilgrimage sites. Lord Badrinarayan (Vishnu) in meditative posture. Temple opens April/May and closes November.

title: Shri Jagannath Temple — Puri
description: One of the four Char Dham. Lord Jagannath — the Lord of the Universe — worshipped in his unique wooden form. Site of the world-famous Rath Yatra.
schedule: Mangala Aarti 5:00 AM | Bhog 12:00 PM | Sandhya Aarti 7:00 PM

title: Somnath Jyotirlinga
description: The first and most sacred Jyotirlinga, destroyed and rebuilt seven times. On the coast of the Arabian Sea — with a sea-facing Shiva lingam.
schedule: Mangala Aarti 6:00 AM | Sandhya Aarti 7:00 PM | Ratri Shringaar 9:00 PM

title: Tirumala Venkateswara — Tirupati
description: The richest and most visited temple on Earth. Lord Venkateswara receives over 50,000 pilgrims daily. Suprabhatam aarti before dawn is incomparable.
schedule: Suprabhatam 3:00 AM | Thomala 3:30 AM | Archana 4:00 AM (TTD official streams)

title: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: 14 gopurams covered in thousands of painted sculptures. Home to Goddess Meenakshi and her consort Sundareswarar (Shiva).
schedule: Kalasanthi Puja 9:00 AM | Ucchikala Puja 12:00 PM | Sayarakshai 6:00 PM

title: Banke Bihari Temple — Vrindavan
description: The most beloved Krishna temple in Vrindavan. The deity is revealed for just seconds at a time — keeping devotees in perpetual longing.
schedule: Mangala Aarti 7:45 AM | Rajbhog 12:00 PM | Sandhya Aarti 5:30 PM
